message.content: Recent literature on cognition highlights that effective action in temporally extended tasks requires memory mechanisms to overcome purely present-focused, Markovian processing. Attentional processes exhibit a ballistic commitment point, reflecting a high-level skill that once initiated cannot be interrupted.
